name: Collared Crossed-Subcube Cap Obstructions
statement: Let $X=\{a,b,p,q,z\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}W$, $U=W\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{z\}$, and $V=\varnothing$. Adding the collared deleted cap $\{\{a,b,p,z\}\cup S:S\subseteq W\}$ to the $(1,0)$ crossed base leaves a learning space rooted at $\{a,b,p\}$. The endpoints $R=\{b,p\}$ and $\bar R=\{a,q\}\cup U$ have repair sets $\{a,q\}$ and $X\setminus\{a\}$. The pendant extension is contraction-minimal nonlearning of order $2^d-7\cdot2^{d-5}$.
proof: After translating by the displayed valid root, every missing block is hereditary in an anchor coordinate, and a casewise deletion proves accessibility. Rooted-union witnesses give the full first hole set and the sole second-endpoint hole. The repair sets cover $X$, and counting the two wings plus the disjoint cap yields the order.
